function_calls.name: Exploration-conclude_no_fallacy
function_calls.arguments: {"reason": "The text's reasoning is an appeal to authority: it treats expert unanimity as proof that a claim is true, and then says non-experts' opinions do not count. That is not a hasty generalisation built from impressions or anecdotes. None of the subtree nodes fit: it is not an argument built on an anecdote (Preuve anecdotique), an appeal to ignorance, an unsupported demand for acceptance (Acte de foi), an empty argument, or an ad hoc rescue. The fitting category sits in a different branch of the taxonomy, not under G\u00e9n\u00e9ralisation h\u00e2tive."}
